title: CompoundRisk
description: A named risk pattern that fires when N controls co-fail on related assets. Called 'chain' in the CLI.

member_controls.description: Control IDs that must ALL be in VIOLATION state.

narrative.description: Attack story: how an attacker exploits this combination.

preconditions.description: Capabilities an attacker needs before this chain is exploitable.

postconditions.description: Capabilities an attacker gains if this chain is present.
